name: ecommerce-observations
description: Live ride-along recorder/reporter for ecommerce shopping. Observes your real browsing session (or drives it yourself in --drive mode) across the funnel (landing → search → category → PDP → cart → checkout), capturing flow, findability, friction, GTM/dataLayer tracking gaps, WebMCP agent-readiness, and named patterns (B2C and B2B/B2B2C) with fast quick-mark notes and upfront/persistent site context, then synthesizes a dive report with a visual funnel storyboard.
